capabilities: merge notes selected in the file explorer into one note
set the title of the merged note
reorder notes with drag-and-drop before merging
place the merged note in the first selected note's folder
extras: Credits the @dnd-kit library for drag-and-drop reordering.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to combine multiple selected notes into a single note from the file explorer.
summary: File-explorer plugin that merges several selected notes into one new note, with a settable title and drag-and-drop ordering.
